summary.zh: BGM / 音效工作台，包含玩家端搜索试听和 AI 端游戏音效接入 Skill。输入 /game-audio 后，Agent 会读取策划与代码，生成 Audio Plan，批量精准检索、幂等挂载、接通真实游戏事件并自动审计。
summary.en: The BGM & SFX workbench combines player-facing search and preview with an AI game-audio integration skill. Type /game-audio to turn design and code into an Audio Plan, retrieve and attach assets in a batch, bind real game events, and audit the result.

body.zh:
玩家端：搜索、筛选、试听音频素材
AI端：需求分析、Audio Plan、精准检索、批量挂载、事件接入
body.en:
Player: search, filter, and preview audio
AI: requirements, Audio Plan, precise retrieval, batch attach, and event binding

body.zh:
/game-audio
resolve-audio-plan → apply-audio-plan → 播放器适配 → 事件绑定 → 自动审计
body.en:
/game-audio
resolve-audio-plan → apply-audio-plan → player adaptation → event binding → automated audit

body.zh:
玩家端：面板管理启用 → 打开「音乐音效」
AI端：在聊天框输入 /game-audio
body.en:
Player: enable it in Admin → open BGM & SFX
AI: type /game-audio in chat
